methodology.valuation: Invest 100 at the beginning of the window, hold, do not reinvest distributions, and mark to current value.
methodology.option_income: Current seller-executable bid is mechanically annualized by 365/DTE. BTC uses Deribit; listed US options prefer CBOE delayed Greeks/quotes with a Yahoo fallback. Daily snapshots build the historical estimate series.
methodology.best_strategy: Option matrices rank premium yield divided by |delta|^1.2, adjusted for DTE, IV versus recent realized volatility, and liquidity.
